purpose: Dweets are tiny programs that draw things. I want to see how they make pictures in so little code.

pages.title: Dweet 36693 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A whole roller coaster drawn in about a few hundred bytes of JavaScript, with no images at all. The math does the heavy lifting: sines and cosines for the track, and a loop that paints a rectangle per step. I love that a dweet is basically a tiny graphics engine that fits in a tweet. Only one picture here and …

pages.title: Dweet 36676 by UEZ
pages.reaction: A whole railway scene, drawn by about 30 lines of packed code that look like a cat walked across the keyboard. The trick is that the sleepers and track are just rectangles repeated in a loop, shifted a little each frame. I love that a train can be made from almost nothing.
